title: MAP privilege request, decision, list reply and audit record
description: Payloads of the Experimental Privilege extension. Envelopes wrap the request/decision/list reply; auditRecord is the Node-local JSONL line written for every terminal outcome.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the executable bytes

risk.description: Advisory classification shown to the approver. shell is reserved for implementations that still allow shells; conformant Nodes reject those requests before emitting a request event.

taskId.description: Requester-supplied task hint. Untrusted: Nodes must not authorize on it; it may be empty or forged.

peerUid.description: Kernel-reported uid of the local sudo client. Present on Linux Nodes; clients must tolerate absence on older Nodes.

program.description: The argv[0] the requester asked for, exactly as displayed to the approver.

resolved.description: Absolute, canonicalized executable path pinned at approval time (symlinks resolved). Present on conformant Nodes.

args.description: Exact argument vector; one request executes exactly one argv.

reason.description: Agent-supplied justification shown to the approver; may be empty.

expiresAt.description: Unix milliseconds; createdAt + 120000 in the reference Node.

scope.description: Only single-shot approval exists. Other values must be rejected with conflict.

approver.description: Ignored from clients. The Node records the authenticated Admin session subject; never trust a client-supplied value.
Authenticated Admin subject, or empty when no decision was made.

scope.description: Decision scope, or empty for timeout/expiry.

detail.description: exit=<code> for executed, the failure text for failed, otherwise empty.
